latestVersion.changelog:
Animated Video Creator 1.0.0 — initial release

- Create animated 1080p MP4 videos from text or images in 1-2 minutes using a cloud GPU pipeline.
- Supports PNG, JPG, MP4, and GIF uploads up to 200MB.
- Offers a free trial with 100 credits for new users; simple anonymous token signup available.
- Key actions include upload, generate videos, check credit balance, view status, and export.
- Common workflows: quick script-to-video, batch processing, and iterative editing with timeline state management.
